name: Canglang Harpoon (Thương Lãng Lao)
lore: The founder's harpoon, its line woven from the sinew of the first whale Trạc Anh Đài ever took (830). Đoàn Thanh Lãng has carried it since 1080 and never thrown it at a man.
build_use: The sea hunter's bind-and-delay: physical damage, longer Binds, sustain on a Bound foe.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Coat of the Old Ivory (Lão Nha Kình Bì Giáp)
lore: Cut from a strip of hide the white whale the hunters call the Old Ivory left on the harpoon the night it took the founder (1080). Đoàn wears it to remember which whale he owes.
build_use: A body cultivator's long fight in cold water: health, shield, regeneration.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Roosting Geese Beads (Tê Nhạn Châu)
lore: One hundred and eight beads of marsh-goose bone, the prayer string of the last abbot of Tê Nhạn Quán, who brought his disciples to the terrace in 1095 (V086).
build_use: The palm monk's rhythm: steadier linh lực for the Hundred Echo Palm.

name: Sworn-Ice Ring (Thệ Băng Giới)
lore: An iron ring set with a chip of the river ice he went through at sixteen; Thẩm Hàn Giang cut it out of the hole the night he pulled him out.
build_use: A hunter's ring: weight on the line and the health to hold it.
